WITH actor_counts AS (
  SELECT actor_id, COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS film_count
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY actor_id
),
film_total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS distinct_film_count
  FROM film_actor
),
actor_values AS (
  SELECT ac.actor_id,
         ac.film_count,
         ac.film_count / ft.distinct_film_count AS film_share
  FROM actor_counts ac
  CROSS JOIN film_total ft
)
SELECT actor_id,
       film_count,
       film_share,
       film_share - AVG(film_share) OVER () AS difference_from_average
FROM actor_values
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average is across actors represented in film_actor, and each actor’s film count uses distinct film IDs.
